title: Underlined Tabs
description: Tabs with no frame around them: $border={false} removes the root edge, $p on Tabs sets the space around the tabs, a bottom border divides the strip from the panels, $kind="flat" removes the folder shape, and the bar prop underlines the selected tab. The panels sit directly on the page surface. Use it for tabs at the top of a page section, and prefer the baseline folder tabs when the tabs and panel should read as one card.
